definitions.explanation: Having no obstacles or impediments; able to move or act freely. Originally a Buddhist term meaning freedom from all barriers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{融通無碍|ゆうずうむげ}→融通無碍：24986_yuuzuumuge⟧な⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: A flexible, unhindered way of thinking is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無碍|むげ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: He expressed his opinion freely and without restraint.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧{無碍|むげ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{天下|てんか}→天下：12188_tenka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{僧侶|そうりょ}→僧侶：11529_souryo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{描|えが}かれている→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: The story depicts a monk traveling the land freely and without hindrance.

notes:
From Buddhist terminology, literally "without obstruction" (⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ = without, {碍|げ} = obstacle/hindrance). Also written as {無礙|むげ}. Most commonly encountered as part of four-character compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{融通無碍|ゆうずうむげ}→融通無碍：24986_yuuzuumuge⟧ — completely flexible; adaptable without constraint
- {自由無碍|じゆうむげ} — completely free; unrestricted
- {縦横無碍|じゅうおうむげ} — freely in all directions; without any restriction

USAGE:
Rarely used as a standalone adjective in modern speech. Most often appears in four-character compounds (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧). These compounds are used in written language and formal speech to describe unrestricted freedom of action or thought.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧ — free; freedom (everyday word for freedom, without the literary/Buddhist overtone)
- {闊達|かったつ} — open-minded; magnanimous (describes personality rather than absence of obstacles)
